scene: Inside the rattling mail train, pneumatic tubes hiss above velvet passenger seats.
beats: You snatch the fluttering letter, but it nips your thumb and flutters toward the sliding doors as the train halts at Lost Property Depot.
The badger nods wisely and slips a velvet key into your palm just as the brakes hiss and the Depot doors slide wide.
Warm lavender steam billows from the pipe, soothing the rattling carriage as it glides to a stop and the doors part at the Depot.
picture: Flat side view inside the mail carriage. At far left, a winged envelope hovers. On the left, a badger in a vest sorts mail. Centre stands the player in his orange jacket and beanie. Up high, overhead pipes feature a brass valve. On the right, windows show receding rooftops.
shown: a fluttering parcel with tiny feather wings, mid-air at the far left
a dapper badger postal clerk sorting cartas at a desk on the left
a gleaming pressure valve attached to overhead copper pipes up high

after.label: Step off at Lost Property Depot
Stay on
after.beat: You stay put as the Depot slips away, watching telegraph poles whizz past until the line ends. Hitching a ride on a friendly tow truck, you pull up outside the buzzing, colourful Neon Sign Hospital.
after.then: Step off at Neon Sign Hospital

variants.scene: A winged parcel hovers inside the clattering mail train carriage at twilight.
beats: You grab the winged box, but it pecks your finger and swoops toward the opening doors as the train halts at Lost Property Depot.
The badger gives a polite nod and hands you a tiny velvet key just as the brakes hiss open at Lost Property Depot.
Lavender steam puffs into the air, steadying the bumpy ride until the mail train rolls safely into Lost Property Depot and its doors open.
variants.ride_on: You ride past the platform and watch the city flicker by. At the final stop, a friendly tow truck driver gives you a lift straight to Neon Sign Hospital.

variants.scene: Sunset glows outside the rattling train window while you hum {tune}.
beats: You catch the fluttering parcel, but it playfully bites your mitten and zips outside as the carriages stop at Lost Property Depot.
The badger whispers postal secrets and presses a velvet key into your coat pocket right as the doors part at Lost Property Depot.
A fragrant cloud of lavender mist gushes forth, calming the squeaky wheels as the train pulls into Lost Property Depot and the doors part.
variants.ride_on: Remaining aboard, you leave the depot behind and ride to the end of the line. A cheerful tow truck scoops you up and drops you off at Neon Sign Hospital.

variants.scene: Paper parcels and copper pipes shudder inside the busy evening mail carriage.
beats: Your hands cup the little winged package, but it pinches your palm and darts out as the train stops at Lost Property Depot.
The smart badger bows, slipping a soft velvet key into your hand just before the brakes squeal and the Depot doors slide wide.
Sweet lavender vapour fills the compartment, softening the ride until the train brakes smoothly and the doors open at Lost Property Depot.
variants.ride_on: Skipping the depot, you let the rails carry you to the terminal. From there, you hitch a ride on an amiable tow truck right to Neon Sign Hospital.
